final: WITH g AS (SELECT e.link_to_budget AS lb, b.event_status AS es, AVG(e.cost) AS ac FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.link_to_budget, b.event_status), o AS (SELECT AVG(ac) AS oa FROM g) SELECT g.es AS event_status, AVG(g.ac) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(g.ac - o.oa) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ac > o.oa GROUP BY g.es
